status: Design and art production only; not implemented or added to the current 60-boss count

bosses.name: Ashen Usher
bosses.lore: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find.
bosses.silhouette: Tall, narrow, weathered theatre usher; one broad ticket rack is the sole prop.
bosses.signature: Breakable ticket stands fire staggered, clearly warned aisle volleys; destroying the selected stand opens a reliable escape aisle.
phases: Dismissal: crossing rows with an open aisle
Final Call: walking usher and sweeping aisle pairs
bosses.counterplay: Read the aisle sequence, cross after a volley, or break the marked ticket stand to open a wider route.

bosses.name: Brass Toad
bosses.lore: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain.
bosses.silhouette: Squat broad bronze fountain toad, four complete legs, one short pipe on its back; simple matte patina.
bosses.signature: Locked, telegraphed hops land with real gapped ripple projectiles. Later phases add a second hop and a warned tongue lane; breaking the drain plug interrupts a jet.
phases: Drizzle: one hop and a ripple
Dry Mouth: tongue lane and ripple pairs
bosses.counterplay: Leave the landing circle, cross the ripple gap, and sidestep the locked tongue lane; strike the drain plug for an interruption.

bosses.name: Ragpicker's Kite
bosses.lore: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street.
bosses.silhouette: One broad, weathered cloth kite shaped like a hunched bird; quiet stitched fabric masses and two readable pin tethers.
bosses.signature: Floating orbit and warned wind corridors push survivors through bullet fans. Breakable cloth pins cut a corridor; server and prediction share the same bounded force.
phases: Crosswind: opposing corridors with a quiet center
Unravelling: orbit, wind and staggered wing fans
bosses.counterplay: Follow corridor arrows, use the quiet lane or break a highlighted cloth pin to remove its wind.
